caption: The drawing depicts a three-drawer wooden chest or dresser, viewed at an angle from the front left. The chest is mostly brown, showing a wood grain texture across all visible surfaces, including the top, sides, and drawer fronts. Each of the three drawers has a keyhole in the center, suggesting that they can be locked. The drawers are decorated with two ornate, leaf- and fruit-like handles positioned symmetrically on either side of the keyhole. The handles and keyholes are colored in a way that complements the brown wood, possibly brass or another metallic shade, but the overall tone remains within brown and earth-toned hues. The dresser sits on four short legs, the front two having a slight inward curve at the bottom. The background is an off-white or beige color, giving the drawing a neutral, lightly textured backdrop.
title: Chest
